description: Canonical ACOS lifecycle hooks projected to native client hook surfaces. Each lifecycle hook is a semantic requirement; clients with a safe native hook surface enforce it automatically, while every other adapter projects the same requirement into its mandatory rules and explicit entrypoints.

BeforeMutation.description: Inspect protected paths and the authority boundary before file mutations (writes/edits only — not shell commands).
BeforeMutation.prompt: ACOS lifecycle hook: BeforeMutation. SCOPE GUARD: If the target file is OUTSIDE the project root (e.g. ~/.claude/projects/, ~/.cursor/), skip — this hook does not apply. For files inside the project: check .ssot/protected-paths.json for a rule whose `path` glob matches the target AND whose `actions` includes the action (write|edit|delete). If a matching `level: deny` or `level: ask` rule covers the action, stop and ask the user. Otherwise proceed — protected-paths.json is the sole gate. Do NOT invent criteria (sensitivity, permission_mode, content subject). The user's task is sufficient authority. Do NOT block based on permission_mode or bypassPermissions. If ecosystemParent is declared in clients.json, also check the parent's protected-paths.json.

AfterMutation.description: Advisory post-mutation check for code files and SSOT drift (writes/edits only — not shell commands).
AfterMutation.prompt: ACOS lifecycle hook: AfterMutation. Advisory, not blocking. After editing a file: (1) code file (Py/JS/TS) with linter/tests configured → run smallest relevant check (ruff/mypy/pytest for one file); (2) file under .ssot/ → run `npx --no-install acos --check` only if acos is locally installed, skip silently on E404 or command-not-found; (3) markdown/docs/config/specs → no check, proceed. If no check applies, continue without hesitation.

BeforeCompletion.description: Persist .ssot/status.md and .ssot/handoff.md; run acos --check only when the harness is locally installed.
BeforeCompletion.prompt: ACOS lifecycle hook: BeforeCompletion. Before ending the session: update .ssot/status.md with progress and write .ssot/handoff.md if this is a session boundary. Optionally run `npx --no-install acos --check` ONLY if acos is locally installed — skip silently on E404 or command-not-found (acos is not published to npm). Do NOT block session end on a missing or failing acos command.

OnSessionResume.description: Read durable status and handoff before selecting the next action.
OnSessionResume.prompt: ACOS lifecycle hook: OnSessionResume. Read .ssot/status.md and .ssot/handoff.md, inspect git status, and use the recorded context to choose the smallest justified next action. If the project declares an ecosystemParent in clients.json, also read the parent's .ssot/handoff.md in addition to the local one.

OnInfrastructureUse.description: Discover the configured external profile first; never deploy a substitute because discovery failed.
OnInfrastructureUse.prompt: ACOS lifecycle hook: OnInfrastructureUse. Before using shared infrastructure, read .ssot/infrastructure.md and run the configured discovery adapter. Use only the configured logical services; do not fall back to a substitute or create a new deployment because discovery failed.

OnNativeClientVerification.description: Prefer mechanical checks over live sessions; warn the user and obtain explicit approval before launching more than one live 040-resume session in a batch; record the date, client, and version in the native verification checklist after any live session.
OnNativeClientVerification.prompt: ACOS lifecycle hook: OnNativeClientVerification. Prefer mechanical verification (npm run native:check) over live native-client sessions. If a live 040-resume session is required, warn the user and obtain explicit approval before launching more than one in a batch. Record the date, client, and version in docs/native-verification-checklist.md after any live session.

OnEcosystemAccess.description: Fires when an agent accesses files outside the project root but inside a declared ecosystemParent or ecosystemChildren path.
OnEcosystemAccess.prompt: ACOS lifecycle hook: OnEcosystemAccess. When accessing files outside the project root, verify the target path is inside a declared ecosystemParent or ecosystemChildren path from clients.json. If it is, proceed safely — the access is expected. If the path is outside both the project root and any declared ecosystem path, stop and ask the user for explicit authority before proceeding.

eve.notes: Eve hooks are post-event observers and cannot implement pre-action gates (BeforeMutation, BeforeCompletion). All lifecycle requirements are projected as always-on instructions instead. See clients.json eve.projections.hooks.
